retainedContract.baselineIdentity: Full commit of actually published 5A supplied by operator; no Site83 default and no future commit assumed

limits: Only source adaptation and AST structure were checked; the planner behavior was not executed.
Future invocation is forbidden until final 4B cost execution/integrity is passed and the completed delivery is committed with a clean tracked/untracked checkout.
The preserved passed_window guard checks completed ABBA executions and integrity; it does not recompute the independent global budget decision or prove publication provenance.
The exact published 5A base and remote predecessor must be established by root; the planner intentionally performs no remote lookup.
A future planner invocation writes local Git tree/commit objects and one exclusive JSON plan outside the checkout, while preserving HEAD, refs, the real index and worktree.
Forty MiB of raw newly reachable object contents provides headroom below the observed sixty-four MiB server limit; it is not a measured or guaranteed wire-pack size.
Untransportable individual objects or ancestry remain a retained failure; no history, target path or proof is removed.
Only the standard authorized Sites helper may execute planned ordinary pushes afterward; no intermediate Site deployment or force-push is authorized by this adaptation.
qualification: Prospective 4B transport tooling only. Existing 5A source is unchanged. The only executable-source differences are declared path/default-window and label literals; AST is identical after reversing those literals. No transport plan, graph/cost execution, build rerun, source push or publication occurred.
